grammar.summary: 本课以河流与农场生活为线索，集中运用了定语从句、虚拟语气（would/should）以及分词结构作状语。课文用 which 引导定语从句修饰河流与农场，用 would 表示对过去事件的假设推断，用分词短语描写河边迎四季与洪水中筏子出现的场景。

points.title: 定语从句 (Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: 用 which/who 引导定语从句修饰先行词并补充信息。本课用 which 修饰 river（形成边界的河流），用 whose 引导定语从句修饰邻居的农场，使叙述层次分明。

examples.en: The river which forms the eastern boundary of our farm has always played an important part in our lives.
examples.cn: 形成我们农场东部边界的一条河流一直在我们生活中发挥着重要作用。

examples.en: we were worried about our nearest neighbors, whose farm was low lying and who were newcomers to the district.
examples.cn: 不过，我们很为我们的近邻担心。他们的农场地势低洼，而且他们又新来乍到。

points.title: 虚拟语气表推测 (would / must have done)
points.explanation: 用 would have + 过去分词表示对过去情况的假设推断，用 must have + 过去分词表示对过去事实的肯定推测。本课用 would have stood stoutly 推断房屋若被淹仍会坚固，用 must have become frightened 推断邻居一定被洪水吓坏了。

examples.en: We realized that they must have become unduly frightened by the rising flood, for their house, which had sound foundations, would have stood stoutly even if it had been almost submerged.
examples.cn: 我们意识到他们一定是被不断上涨的洪水吓坏了。因为他们的房子地基牢固，即使洪水几乎灭顶也不会倒塌。

points.title: 分词结构作状语 (Participle Clauses)
points.explanation: 现在分词短语作状语表示伴随动作或方式。本课用 crowning...holding...giving...throwing... 一组并列分词描写河边迎四季的仪式，用 carrying 描写筏子载物的状态，画面感强。

examples.en: We welcome the seasons by the riverside, crowning the youngest girl with flowers in the spring, holding a summer festival on Midsummer Eve, giving thanks for the harvest in the autumn, and throwing a holy wreath into the current in the winter.
examples.cn: 我们在河边迎接一年四季。春天在河边为最年轻的姑娘戴上花冠，夏天在河边欢庆“仲夏前夜”，秋天在河边丰收而感恩，冬天往河中抛撒一个冬表花环。

examples.en: Suddenly a raft appeared, looking rather like Noah's ark, carrying the whole family, a few hens, the dogs, cat, and bird in a cage.
examples.cn: 突然，出现了一只筏子，看起来很像诺亚方舟，上面载着他们全家老小，还有几只母鸡、几只狗，一只猫与一只鸟笼，那里头有一只小鸟。

exercises.q: The river ______ forms the eastern boundary of our farm has always played an important part in our lives.
We realized that they ______ become unduly frightened by the rising flood.
We welcome the seasons by the riverside, ______ the youngest girl with flowers in the spring, holding a summer festival on Midsummer Eve...
用定语从句的关系代词填空：we were worried about our nearest neighbors, ______ farm was low lying and who were newcomers to the district.
课文中 would have stood stoutly even if it had been almost submerged 中 stood stoutly 的含义最接近？
